description: Erection of a first floor side and rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the information shown in the submitted drawings and Condition 3 below and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 or any instrument that may supersede it, the extension shall be finished in red facing bricks to match the existing house and the house shall not be rendered.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (AH 730 01; AH 730 02  Received:  01 May 2020
AH 730 03 (Ref F); AH 730 04 (Rev F); Unreferenced Site Location Plan  Received:  30 January 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the first floor side and rear extensions hereby approved.
